name: reflectron-heavy-ion
description: Closed form: the focused reflectron time scaled by sqrt(2000/500) = 2 exactly. The focused single-stage reflectron flown with m/z 2000 instead of 500. At fixed accelerating potential the speed goes as 1/sqrt(m) and every term of the flight time goes as sqrt(m), so a four-fold mass gives exactly twice the time: 20.3610 us against 10.1805. That exact factor of two is the sharpest statement of what a time-of-flight instrument measures, and it is a stronger check than it looks - a field or a charge entering the wrong power would break it while leaving one mass looking right.
